يستحرما (form X)
# يَسْتَحْرِمَا (yastaḥrimā) /jas.taħ.ri.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# يُسْتَحْرَمَا (yustaḥramā) /jus.taħ.ra.maː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
